Subject: Hide legend for some lines

 

Hi, folks

help needed, your reply will be much appreciated.

I use the following code to generate a plot:

## --------------------------- ggplot2  -----------------------------------------
dta <- data.frame(x = rep(1:10, 3),
                  y = cumsum(rnorm(30)),
                  grp = rep(c("show", "hide1", "hide2"), each=10))

p <- ggplot(dta, aes(x, y, color=grp)) + geom_line()
p

messages.subject: Re: Hide legend for some lines
parts:
Hi,

I would use two layers with subsets of the data,


dta1 <- subset(dta, grepl("hide", grp))
dta2 <- subset(dta, grp %in% c("show1", "show2"))

p <- ggplot(dta, aes(x, y, group=grp)) + 
  geom_line(data=dta1, colour="grey") +
  geom_line(data=dta2, aes(colour=grp)) 
  
p

HTH,

baptiste

messages.author: d588a03e58ea7e7f
messages.subject: Re: Hide legend for some lines
parts:
On 4/23/2013 6:02 AM, Yue wrote:
> Hi, folks
>
> help needed, your reply will be much appreciated.
>
> I use the following code to generate a plot:
>
> ## --------------------------- ggplot2
> -----------------------------------------
> dta <- data.frame(x = rep(1:10, 3),
> y = cumsum(rnorm(30)),
> grp = rep(c("show", "hide1", "hide2"), each=10))
>
> p <- ggplot(dta, aes(x, y, color=grp)) + geom_line()
> p
> ##
> ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>
> The plot has three lines, however, I only want to show legend of one of
> them (labeled "show"). Can I customize the legend as desired?

You can put a vector of which levels to show in the breaks argument for
the scale.

p + scale_colour_discrete(breaks=c("show"))

--
Brian S. Diggs, PhD
Senior Research Associate, Department of Surgery
Oregon Health & Science University
